trust.role: The same upstream Anon Aadhaar public test QR and test certificate as material/anon_aadhaar (files are shared, not copied). Upstream publishes the matching private key, so this issuer is never a trust anchor outside tests. Not a UIDAI credential.
algorithms: RSA-2048 PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 over the decompressed Secure QR V2 payload
trust.rotationRevocation: Fixed historical test data; the self-signed test certificate expired 2025-03-01. Production deployments pin a current UIDAI key hash instead.
trust.authentication: File hashes match the pinned upstream commit (recorded for anon_aadhaar). Signature checked on the host with node:crypto and in Noir with the native verifier.

verification.method: Host: decompress, split and node:crypto RSA-SHA256 verification against testCertificate.pem; parsed fields equal the fixture's published field values. Circuit: native Noir verify() with UPSTREAM_TEST_ISSUER_KEY_HASH.

trust.role: Upstream test QR fields rearranged (2032 timestamp, re-issue with a new photo, new name, maximal lengths, too-long name) and re-signed with the repository's public synthetic RSA-2048 key. Test-only; the private key is checked in.
trust.authentication: Generated locally; the host verifies each signature before writing the vectors.

verification.method: Native Noir verify() with the synthetic key hash; expected issuance times from independent host Date.UTC code.

acquisitionNotes.reason: No authenticated current UIDAI offline-QR signing certificate is in the repository (see material/anon_aadhaar). The upstream copy of uidai_offline_publickey_26022021.cer (expired 2024-02-27) is used only for a key-hash test vector, not as trust material.
